verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's CUDA Toolkit is documented as the development environment for GPU-accelerated applications in enterprise data centers, and NVIDIA's developer pages reference the Hopper H200 alongside its software stack (AI Enterprise, TensorRT-LLM benchmarks, HPC SDK). However, no cited CUDA document explicitly lists the H200 as a supported target or gives its compute capability. Community comments that it uses the same GH100 die as the H100 make support likely but do not document it. missing for 10: an explicit CUDA supported-GPU or compute-capability listing naming the H200, toolkit/driver version requirements, and independent hands-on confirmation of shipping CUDA workloads on the H200.
